plan.title: Reject surrogate bid without rebid permission

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before opening the existing event.
Open the RFQ Responses view where Vendor A's bid can be rejected.
Open the rejection dialog for Vendor A's bid.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid by Vendor A

steps.note: Verify the dialog identifies the correct vendor and rejection action.
Leave rebidding disabled for Vendor A.

args.text: Supplier would not be allowed to bid again. This action cannot be undone.

steps.note: Verify the irreversible no-rebid warning is shown.
Confirm rejection of Vendor A's bid.
Verify Vendor A's bid is marked rejected in Responses.

args.text: You have blocked the supplier from bidding again.

steps.note: Verify the buyer receives confirmation that Vendor A was blocked from rebidding.
Open the RFQ Rejected Bids view.

args.text: Rejection Remark: Price not valid — QA

steps.note: Verify the rejected-bid record contains the entered remark.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier portal view.
Open the event's pricing round as Vendor A.
Verify Vendor A can see the rejection reason in the vendor portal.
Attempt to submit another bid as Vendor A and verify the blocked supplier cannot rebid.
Leave the final vendor-side assertion on the rejected state.
